verdicts.quote: readBytes method at line 86: `final long contentLength = unsignedExtend(in.readInt());` reads untrusted 32-bit length. Line 88 allocates: `new byte[(int)contentLength]` without size validation beyond Integer.MAX_VALUE check (2.1 GB).
verdicts.why: The exploit described is the untrusted length prefix sizing the byte array, with the allocation performed on the declared size alone - before the payload it claims is shown to exist.

verdicts.quote: No recursion depth counter or limit is present. Stack depth is unbounded based on message nesting level.
verdicts.why: F02 is exactly the uncounted decode cycle: readFieldValue -> readTable/readArray -> readFieldValue, with message nesting controlling depth.
